director: THE LOOK (this film's preset: DESIGNED — the channel's own designed 3D cartoon; the engine applies it to every shot on top of your look block; you never set it): the channel's DESIGNED CAST rebuilt in 3D. Every person is one of the channel's designed characters WITH A FACE (this look is the ONE exception to "faceless"): the engine builds every cast member, every `figure.*` group and every `figure.person` in the channel's design automatically (a big round head with flat 2D face marks, a modelled jacket, stick limbs, gloves, small round shoes), so stage people exactly as usual. Give every CastDef a `designed` block for its outfit: {"top": jacket|hoodie|track|tshirt|sweater|labcoat|suit|dress|chef|coverall, "color": "#hex", "trim": "#hex", "hat": {"kind": cap|beret|beanie|hardhat|chef|crown|band|none, "color": "#hex"}, "glasses": true|false, "expression": a face}; copy the channel's cast exactly as the creator's notes give it (the same main character, same outfit, in every scene). FACES ACT: put "face" on a cast entry (the whole shot) or on any actions entry ({t, action, face}): neutral|happy|smile|laugh|excited|surprised|shocked|scared|worried|sad|angry|determined|thinking|confused|sleepy|tired|wink|smug|disgusted|pain|dizzy|love|calm; a speaking character's mouth moves by itself (action speak, or "talk": true). The world is one of the DESIGNED SETS (biome designed_room with furnish bedroom|living|lab|office|kitchen|classroom, designed_street, designed_city, designed_track, designed_park); pick the place the words are in and build any object the set doesn't have with prop.build in simple primitives and flat bright colours (the channel's props are simple low-poly shapes). Bright daylight (morning, noon, afternoon, golden); dusk or night only when the story is at night. Faces carry the story: most shots are medium or close on a character, face toward the camera or three-quarter, with a wide to set each new place.
review: THE LOOK IS INTENTIONAL (it overrides every "faceless" / "faces at all" / "a mannequin with a face" rule of the rubric and of QUALITY.md: in this look the people are the channel's designed characters and their FACES ARE REQUIRED) — this film uses the DESIGNED preset, the channel's own 3D cartoon: round black heads with a cream rim of light and flat white face marks that change with the expression, modelled bright jackets, stick legs, gloves, two-tone cel light, thin outlines, bright simple low-poly sets. That is the look: never score the faces, the proportions, the flat colours or the simple shapes as cheap or wrong, and never fix them toward realism. Judge the craft inside the look: the character reads at a glance and wears the same outfit in every shot, the face's expression fits the words, the action and the place show what the words say, the camera moves. The hard fails H1-H8 still apply.

cookbook:
LOOK PRESET designed (this film) — the channel's designed 3D cartoon. How to stage it:
- THE CAST: one CastDef per character with a `designed` block (top, color, hat, glasses); the main character keeps one outfit for the whole video. A character is ~1.6 m tall, the head a 0.4 m ball with the face at ~1.4 m; extras and groups are built in the same design (figure.crowd count <= 14: whole characters; more: little people for stands and streets).
- FACES: "face" on the cast entry or per actions entry, changed on the word (a surprise lands on its word: {t, action: 'watch', face: 'shocked'}). Talking characters: action speak (the mouth moves). Close shots read the face: keys at 1.2-1.6 m with "limits": "macro" (fov 30-42), 1.2-2.5 m from the face, always moving (push 15-30 %, arc 15-30°), with a shallow focus ("dof": 1.2) like the channel's close shots. Medium shots 2.5-4 m, full shots 4-7 m; over-the-shoulder two-shots for conversations.
- THE SETS: designed_room is a 7 x 6 m room round the stage, open toward +z (film from z 1.5..3 looking -z, or from the sides); its furniture stands where the catalog says (bedroom: the bed against the back wall at x -1.7). designed_street: the stage on a front path, the road 5 m south along x. designed_city: the stage on the north pavement, the avenue along x. designed_track: the stage on lane 4 of the home straight, lanes along x, the stands south. designed_park: an open lawn, trees, a skyline north.
- ACTION: the engine's actions (walk, run, sprint, point, wave, cheer, speak, watch, sit, kneel, take_cover ...) on paths; a run along the track or the street, a camera following beside it (keys moving with the runner 3-5 m to the side at 1.2-1.6 m). SUPER SPEED: the runner leaves a glowing streak in its colour with white speed lines: an object {"kind": "designed.trail", "follow": "ref:<id>", "color": "#hex", "t": [t0, t1]} (sprint at a high speed, film it passing a near static camera).
- OBJECTS: what the words name and the set lacks (a phone in the hand, a telescope, a giant eye chart, a TV showing pixels) is prop.build in a few primitives with flat bright colours; held things go in the hand (placement in a figure's hand).
